# CC0 creature sources

**Spider — br-n518**, published 2018-07-29:
https://opengameart.org/content/spider-2.
The submission explicitly labels its downloads CC0 and repeats CC0 in its
attribution notice. `spider.blend` is the exact `spider_1.blend` download;
`spider.png` is the exact `spider_7.png` texture. Source: 222 triangles,
45-bone rig, idle/walk/attack Actions. The saved declaration is spider-page.html.

**Goblin — CDmir, collaborator TinyWorlds**, published 2015-10-03:
https://opengameart.org/content/goblin-1.
The submission explicitly labels the model CC0. `goblin.blend` is the exact
`goblin-FINAL.blend` download, including its packed textures and source Actions.
The saved declaration is goblin-page.html. No private human/Mixamo content.

CC0 deed: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/.
Exact URLs, sizes, SHA256 pins and retained page hashes are in provenance.json.
Original bytes remain unchanged; .gitattributes prevents text normalization of
downloaded evidence. Generated changes are in field-creatures-3d-v1, not here.

Unused candidate previews and the tbbk rigged-goblin comparison remain local in
build/local-spiders-goblin-v1/source; they are not used by any delivered model.
